groups.activity: The War Within, then The Glast Gambit

rows.label: The War Within
rows.note: unlocks The Glast Gambit at relays

conditions: Talk to Ergo Glast in any relay after The War Within to begin the quest.
The wagers escalate from 100,000 to 180,000 credits. Win the first four; a loss burns its wager.
Match 4 requires a 20-point Victory Margin: do not bring Specters and do not win by more than 20, or Nef Anyo withdraws and the wager is lost.
Match 5 is scripted to lose, but bank at least once so the quest advances; refusing to deposit fails it without advancing.
bonuses: Do this once the wagers are disposable; normal Index remains available if you need to rebuild credits.

disclosures.title: the quest blueprint is not an RNG drop
disclosures.body: The Glast Gambit awards the Nidus main blueprint. Infested Salvage only supplies the three component blueprints.

conditions: This is an AABC mission, but Update 42.0 added all three parts to A and B. The old advice that only Rotation C can drop Nidus parts is obsolete.
Run solo: console decryption slows with additional squad members, solo skips the end-of-round wait, and you start each new round with every console active.
Stay through round 4 for the C reward, then extract and restart. Enemy scaling makes deeper rounds slower without better drop odds.
Feed Antiserum Charges to Vaporizers to protect all three consoles. If all three consoles are destroyed, the mission fails.
bonuses: A loot frame or companion increases Antiserum Charge drops: Nekros, Khora, Hydroid, Ivara, Atlas, or Chesa Kubrow.
Kill close to the Vaporizers: Charges have a short despawn timer and cannot be Vacuumed from distant AoE kills.
The clan-researched Antiserum Injector restores armor from the Gear menu without spending a carried Charge; Operator mode also avoids corrosion.

disclosures.title: keep the Vaporizer loop moving
disclosures.body: Carry at most three Charges, circle the three Vaporizers, and top each one up every pass instead of waiting for its bubble to run down. Octavia is a low-attention solo pick: Mallet and Resonator clear nearby Infested while you collect and deliver Charges.

conditions: Finish The Duviri Paradox and check the current Circuit offering before committing to Eris.
Nidus appears on an 11-week Circuit cycle. If his week is near, the guaranteed route avoids all part RNG; if it is far away, farm Oestrus instead.
Infested Salvage itself is a strong Nano Spore source, so farm the part blueprints before separately targeting its common materials.
Queue all three components first; they build in parallel before the 72-hour frame build.
